extracted.intended_audience: Users of the GAP system (new users, students, teachers, developers, and researchers interested in computational algebra)
extracted.subtask_description: Locating and using the primary GAP documentation resources (Tutorial, Reference Manual, CHANGES, package manuals), plus learning and teaching materials and bibliographies related to GAP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tutorial
rubrics_metrics.description: The Tutorial (PDF) gives a first introduction to the system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended as an introductory entry point for new users; provided as a PDF linked from the documentation page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference Manual
rubrics_metrics.description: The Reference Manual (PDF) with complete descriptions of all library functions and examples of their use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves as the authoritative reference for GAP functions and usage; includes examples demonstrating function behavior. Provided as a downloadable PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: CHANGES.md
rubrics_metrics.description: The CHANGES.md file describes most essential changes between all GAP releases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A changelog capturing important release-to-release changes; useful for tracking backward-incompatible changes or new features across versions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Package manuals
rubrics_metrics.description: Each GAP package has its individual manual which you can access through the list of packages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Package-specific documentation is maintained per package and available via the packages list; users should consult package manuals for package functions, examples, and package-specific details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Learning GAP
rubrics_metrics.description: In addition to the Tutorial there is a variety of material intended to help people to learn on their own the GAP language and the use of the GAP system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Learning resources are organized somewhat according to level and intended audience on the linked page; these materials complement the Tutorial and Reference Manual for self-study.

rubrics_metrics.name: Teaching Material
rubrics_metrics.description: GAP has been used in several places to support the teaching of a variety of courses and some course material is pointed to from this page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Course materials are shared to help colleagues intending similar uses and to support students; the GAP project requests access to further such material to expand the collection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bibliographies
rubrics_metrics.description: There is a Google Scholar profile for the GAP system and some of its packages, and zbMATH tracking (GAP at zbMATH) provides a list of publications citing GAP. An old .bib file with GAP-related bibliography is available but not maintained since 2022.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bibliographic resources help users find publications that use or cite GAP and its packages; the page points to automated citation sources (Google Scholar) and curated lists (zbMATH), and offers a downloadable legacy .bib file.
